name: Kern River Apex Expansion
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 700: Apex Expansion Project, Kern River Gas Transmission, completed October 2011, 28 miles, 266 MMcf/d added, 36 inch, FERC docket CP10-14. Not an existing row: P0207 is the 1,717 km main line, P3856 is the Delta Lateral, P5931 Apex Pipeline is unrelated. Offshore Technology project profile says 28 miles of pipe called the Wasatch Loop in Morgan, Davis and Salt Lake counties in Utah, plus a new Milford compressor station in Beaver County, and a cost of 373 million dollars. It calls the pipe 38 inch, but EIA and the FERC filing say 36 inch, so 36 is used. The EIA note lists Wyoming, Utah and Nevada because the whole expansion touched those states, but the new pipe is the Utah loop only, so start and end state are Utah. The EIA cost figure of 30 million does not match the 373 million in the project profile, so only the profile figure is used and the cost has one source. The FERC environmental impact statement page for the Apex Expansion Project (docket CP10-14) loaded and names the project. No official map data was found, so the route is unavailable. Start and end locations are not stated in a source and are left blank; the loop is in the Wasatch Mountains. Length is about 27.6 miles in the FERC description, 28 in EIA. Passes the 25 km length rule at about 45 km. Parent name matches the roster spelling of P0207.
